info.brief: Functionality to work with Play Asset Delivery and the AssetPackManager
info.description: Functionality to work with Play Asset Delivery and the AssetPackManager

elements.name: pad.cancel
elements.description: Requests to cancel the download of the specified asset packs.

elements.name: pad.fetch
elements.description: Requests to download the specified asset pack.

elements.name: pad.remove_pack
elements.description: Deletes the specified asset pack from the internal storage of the app.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_state
elements.description: Requests download state and details for the specified asset pack. This is an asynchronous function and will send a `PACK_STATE_UPDATED` event once the new state is available.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_location
elements.description: Returns the location of the specified asset pack on the device or an empty string if this pack is not downloaded.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_bytes_downloaded
elements.description: Returns the total number of bytes already downloaded for the pack. Note that you must have called the `get_pack_state()` function first and wait for a `PACK_STATE_UPDATED` event before calling this function.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_error_code
elements.description: Returns the error code for the pack, if Play has failed to download the pack. Note that you must have called the `get_pack_state()` function first and wait for a `PACK_STATE_UPDATED` event before calling this function.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_status
elements.description: Returns the download status of the pack. Note that you must have called the `get_pack_state()` function first and wait for a `PACK_STATE_UPDATED` event before calling this function.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_total_bytes_to_download
elements.description: Returns the total size of the pack in bytes. Note that you must have called the `get_pack_state()` function first and wait for a `PACK_STATE_UPDATED` event before calling this function.

elements.name: pad.get_pack_transfer_progress_percentage
elements.description: Returns the percentage of the asset pack already transferred to the app. Note that you must have called the `get_pack_state()` function first and wait for a `PACK_STATE_UPDATED` event before calling this function.

elements.name: pad.show_confirmation_dialog
elements.description: Shows a dialog that asks the user for consent to download packs Shows a dialog that asks the user for consent to download packs that are currently in either the AssetPackStatus.REQUIRES_USER_CONFIRMATION state or the AssetPackStatus.WAITING_FOR_WIFI state. Will return result in event listener.

elements.name: pad.set_listener
elements.description: Set listener to receive events

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_ACCESS_DENIED
elements.brief: Download not permitted under the current device circumstances
elements.description: Download not permitted under the current device circumstances

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_API_NOT_AVAILABLE
elements.brief: The Asset Delivery API isn't available.
elements.description: The Asset Delivery API isn't available.

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_APP_NOT_OWNED
elements.brief: The app isn't owned by any user on this device.
elements.description: The app isn't owned by any user on this device.

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_APP_UNAVAILABLE
elements.description: The requesting app is unavailable.

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_CONFIRMATION_NOT_REQUIRED
elements.brief: Returned if AssetPackManager.showConfirmationDialog(Activity) is called but no asset packs require user confirmation.
elements.description: Returned if AssetPackManager.showConfirmationDialog(Activity) is called but no asset packs require user confirmation.

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_DOWNLOAD_NOT_FOUND
elements.description: The requested download isn't found.

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE
elements.brief: Asset pack download failed due to insufficient storage.
elements.description: Asset pack download failed due to insufficient storage.

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_INTERNAL_ERROR
elements.brief: Unknown error downloading an asset pack.
elements.description: Unknown error downloading an asset pack.

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_INVALID_REQUEST
elements.description: The request is invalid.

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_NETWORK_ERROR
elements.description: Network error.

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_NETWORK_UNRESTRICTED
elements.brief: Returned if AssetPackManager.showCellularDataConfirmation(Activity) is called but no asset packs are waiting for Wi-Fi.
elements.description: Returned if AssetPackManager.showCellularDataConfirmation(Activity) is called but no asset packs are waiting for Wi-Fi.

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_PACK_UNAVAILABLE
elements.brief: The requested asset pack isn't available.
elements.description: The requested asset pack isn't available.

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_PLAY_STORE_NOT_FOUND
elements.brief: The Play Store app is either not installed or not the official version.
elements.description: The Play Store app is either not installed or not the official version.

elements.name: pad.ERRORCODE_UNRECOGNIZED_INSTALLATION
elements.brief: The installed app version is not recognized by Play.
elements.description: The installed app version is not recognized by Play.
